instruction:
1. Please recreate the table of contents in accordance with the requirements in “Graduation Thesis Format for the Higher Education Self-Study Examination at Dongyue Technical College,” and make it an automatically updatable table of contents.
2. I have sent you the thesis requirements. Could you also check whether the formatting of my thesis complies with the requirements and, if it does not, correct it?

dim1: The deliverable file has the .docx extension; the file opens normally.
dim2: +1: The title on the table of contents page uses SimHei, size No. 2.
+1: The two Chinese characters in the “Table of Contents” title are separated by one character space.
+1: The title paragraph on the table of contents page is center-aligned, with 0.5 lines of spacing before, 0.5 lines of spacing after, and double line spacing.
+5: The table of contents is automatically generated.
+3: Chinese text on the table of contents page uses SimSun, size No. 4.
+3: Paragraphs on the table of contents page use 1.5-line spacing; level 1 headings are flush left, level 2 headings are indented by 1 character, and level 3 headings are indented by 2 characters.
+3: Page-number paragraphs on the table of contents page must be right-aligned.
+1: Except for “Abstract,” “Keywords,” and “Research Direction,” all other text on the Chinese abstract page uses SimSun, size No. 4.
+1: The title on the Chinese abstract page uses SimHei, size Small No. 3.
+1: Paragraphs on the Chinese abstract page have 0.5 lines of spacing before, 0.5 lines of spacing after, and double line spacing.
+1: Body paragraphs on the “Declaration of Academic Integrity and Authorization for Use of the Work” page have a first-line indent of 2 characters and single line spacing.
+1: The three-character label “Keywords” on the Chinese abstract page uses SimHei, size No. 4, and bold.
+1: The title on the English abstract page uses Times New Roman, size Small No. 3.
+1: The body text on the English abstract page uses Times New Roman, size No. 4; “Key words:” must be bold.
+1: Body paragraphs on the English abstract page have a first-line indent of 2 characters, justified alignment, and single line spacing.
+1: The thesis title uses size No. 3, SimHei, and bold.
+1: The thesis-title paragraph is center-aligned, with 2 lines of spacing both before and after and double line spacing.
+3: Level 1 headings use size Small No. 3 SimHei.
+3: Level 1 heading paragraphs are center-aligned, with 0.5 lines of spacing both before and after and double line spacing.
+3: Level 2 headings use size No. 4 SimHei and bold.
+3: Level 2 heading paragraphs are flush left with no indentation, with 0.5 lines of spacing both before and after and single line spacing.
+1: The title on the references page uses size Small No. 3 and SimHei.
+1: The title paragraph on the references page is center-aligned, with 0.5 lines of spacing both before and after and double line spacing.
+1: Body text on the references page uses SimSun, size Small No. 4, and black for Chinese text, and Times New Roman, size Small No. 4, and black for English text.
+1: The footer distance from the bottom is 1.50 cm.

+3: The header text is “Graduation Thesis for the Higher Education Self-Study Examination of Dongyue Technical College” or “Graduation Research Report for the Higher Education Self-Study Examination of Dongyue Technical College”; every page of the thesis has a header.
+3: The header uses Noto Serif CJK SC, size No. 5, and center alignment.
+3: Reference citation marking format: add the citation in black superscript before the final period of a quotation or paraphrased viewpoint.
+3: Reference citation format in the thesis: leave one Chinese-character space between the reference number and the reference; align flush left with no indentation and use 1.5-line spacing.
+3: Main-body paragraphs have a first-line indent of 2 characters, 1.5-line spacing, and justified alignment.
-1: The title on the “Higher Education Self-Study Examination Graduation Thesis Cover” page does not meet the requirements of SimSun, size No. 2, and bold.
-1: The title paragraph on the “Higher Education Self-Study Examination Graduation Thesis Cover” page does not meet the requirements of center alignment and fixed line spacing of 29 points.

-3: Except for “Evaluation Item,” “Evaluation Criteria,” and “Score,” the remaining text on the “Higher Education Self-Study Examination Graduation Thesis Cover” page does not meet the requirement of SimSun, size Small No. 4.

-1: The “Evaluation Item,” “Evaluation Criteria,” and “Score” text on the “Higher Education Self-Study Examination Graduation Thesis Cover” page does not meet the requirement of SimHei, size Small No. 4.

-3: The contents of row 6, column 2; row 7, column 2; row 8, column 2; and the cells in row 12 of the table on the “Higher Education Self-Study Examination Graduation Thesis Cover” page do not meet the requirements of left alignment and single line spacing.

-1: The font and paragraph formatting in the address and date sections of the “Higher Education Self-Study Examination Graduation Thesis Cover” page does not meet the requirements of justified alignment, a first-line indent of 2 characters, and line spacing of 29 points.
-1: The title on the “Declaration of Academic Integrity and Authorization for Use of the Work” page does not meet the requirements of size No. 3 SimHei and bold.

-1: The paragraph formatting of “Declaration of Academic Integrity and Authorization for Use of the Work” does not meet the requirements of center alignment, 1 line of spacing before, 1 line of spacing after, and single line spacing.
-1: The body text on the “Declaration of Academic Integrity and Authorization for Use of the Work” page does not meet the requirement of SimSun, size Small No. 4.
-1: Body paragraphs on the Chinese abstract page do not meet the requirements of left alignment, a first-line indent of 2 characters, and 1.5-line spacing.

-1: The paragraph containing the three-character label “Keywords” on the Chinese abstract page does not meet the requirements of left alignment, a first-line indent of 2 characters, and 1.5-line spacing.
-1: The “Research Direction” text on the Chinese abstract page does not meet the requirement of SimHei, size Small No. 4.
-3: Chinese main-body text does not meet the requirement of SimSun, size Small No. 4, and English text and Arabic numerals do not meet the requirement of Times New Roman, size Small No. 4.
-3: Page numbering starts on the abstract page; page numbers on the Chinese and English abstract pages use uppercase Roman numerals, and main-body page numbers use Arabic numerals.
-1: Page numbers use Calibri, size Small No. 5, and center alignment.
-1: The header distance from the top is 1.50 cm.
-3: The header does not include a horizontal line.
-3: The header’s horizontal-line style does not meet the requirements of a double solid line with a width of 3 points.
